defect_classes.violated_invariant: a publication is parented by the state it was decided on (CONTRACT 9.4.2)
a provider answer applies only to the question that asked it; events only in legal states
variants: refused renewal swapped token (third review, low)
defect_classes.reviewer_evidence: closure-review-DC-002-004 (OPEN), closure-review-2 (OPEN: A), closure-review-3 (A CLOSED), closure-review-7 and -8 (CLOSED)

defect_classes.violated_invariant: after a save is sent, no failure is reported as not written
variants: F1-F5, F7 (seventh review: applied save reported unsent or conflict)
R10-1, R10-2 (tenth review: flag reset on re-apply, contradictory text)
defect_classes.reviewer_evidence: closure-review-2 (CLOSED, residual D), closure-review-7 (OPEN), closure-review-8 to -10 (each CLOSED its predecessor's findings; low variants fixed), closure-review-11 (CLOSED; test gap T2 closed by 28d); residual F6 documented

defect_classes.violated_invariant: an absent or advisory provider field never gates or grants
reads of mutable state are never answered from a cache
variants: nonce repeated across page loads (shared cache)
reload answered by a lagging replica (third review)
V1, V2: REST cannot compare-and-swap (sixth review)
defect_classes.reviewer_evidence: live runs 39990408889, 40036025752, 40038654015 PASS; closure-review-3 to -6 (OPEN, each fixed); closure-review-7 and -8 (CLOSED: atomic GraphQL save)

defect_classes.violated_invariant: a failed framework download ends the start promptly with recovery (WASM-LOAD-005)
variants: first fix failed starts the loader would have recovered (third review)
B1: grace expired while a slow retry was downloading (fourth review)
defect_classes.reviewer_evidence: closure-review-3 and -4 (OPEN, each fixed); closure-review-5 (CLOSED; low: wrong message after a fast persistent failure)
